Straight hair has very specific needs — humidity frizz, oily scalp build-up, a lack of natural shine. Most brands treat all hair types the same. Cabello was created to fix that.

Brand Story & Mission

The Story Behind Cabello

Straight hair has very specific needs—like dealing with humidity frizz, oily scalp build-up, and a lack of natural shine—yet most hair care brands treat all hair types the same. Cabello was created to fix that. We build lightweight, botanical-powered formulas that keep straight hair sleek, fresh, and manageable without weighing it down.

Core Brand Pillars

Specifically formulated for straight hair concerns — frizz, oil control, shine.

Powered by natural extracts like Cucumber Water, Green Tea, and Rice Protein.

03

Premium visual design paired with everyday usability.

Product Range

Cabello Hydrating Shampoo

For Maintaining Smoothness & Reducing Frizz

Net Volume: 355 mL / 12 fl ozHero Formula: Cucumber Water & Green Tea Extract (Camellia Sinensis)

A refreshing everyday shampoo formulated with cucumber water and green tea to gently cleanse the hair while helping maintain smooth, sleek and manageable hair.

How to UseApply a small amount to wet hair. Massage gently into the scalp and lengths. Rinse thoroughly. Repeat if required.
IngredientsAqua, Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Cucumber Water, Camellia Sinensis (Green Tea) Extract, Sodium Chloride, Citric Acid, Fragrance, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate.
CautionFor external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water. Keep out of reach of children.

Cabello Hydrating Conditioner

For Maintaining Smoothness & Reducing Frizz

Net Volume: 355 mL / 12 fl ozHero Formula: Hydrolyzed Rice Protein & Panthenol
Reduces FrizzAdds ShineSmooths Hair

A lightweight, nourishing conditioner formulated with rice protein and panthenol to hydrate, detangle and smooth the hair. Helps reduce frizz and leaves hair soft, sleek and manageable.

How to UseAfter shampooing, apply a small amount to wet hair. Focus on mid-lengths and ends. Leave for 1–2 minutes, then rinse thoroughly.
IngredientsAqua, Cetearyl Alcohol, Behentrimonium Chloride, Glycerin, Hydrolyzed Rice Protein, Panthenol, Citric Acid, Fragrance, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate.
CautionFor external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water. Keep out of reach of children.
